subject: Re: Deployment mode qualification — SSO, KMS/HSM, logging retention
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmefinancial.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's call - deployment needs

Thanks for the demo today, Marissa. A few notes from our side after the call so we have alignment:

- We are evaluating two options: Dedicated capacity (for predictable throughput) and Private VPC/on-prem (for full control). Hosted API would be preferred for speed, but there are integrations that may force us off-hosted.
- Key constraints: enterprise SSO (SAML + IdP provisioning), KMS/HSM for key custody, and 7+ years of immutable logging for audit.
- Our security team flagged that KMS keys must be customer-controlled (HSM-backed) and isolated from vendor-managed KMS unless in a private deployment.

Can you confirm which deployment modes support SAML IdP initiated SSO + SCIM provisioning, and what the options are for customer-managed KMS? Also need an initial read on log retention options (policy, export, and immutability).

Thanks,
Alice
Director of Security Operations
Acme Financial
[Attachment: SAML_Integration_Spec.pdf]

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmefinancial.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call - deployment needs

Alice - great to continue the conversation. Summary below and next steps.

Short answers up front:
- SSO: We support SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning across Dedicated and Private deployments; Hosted API supports SAML for workspace-level admin SSO but SCIM provisioning for per-tenant provisioning is only available on Dedicated and Private.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own key) with HSM-backed key stores is available only for Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments today. For Dedicated, we support customer key encryption via a partner KMS integration (customer-managed keys in supported cloud KMS) but not HSM attested modules on our shared hardware.
- Logging retention: Hosted API provides standard audit logs with 30/90/365 day retention tiers. Dedicated and Private allow configurable retention and direct export to your logging endpoint (S3/GCS) for long-term immutable retention; Private can also be configured with append-only retention policies and can satisfy 7+ year retention when paired with your archival store.

Detailed notes from our internal SE (copied):
- SSO/SCIM: We can do IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SAML. For per-user provisioning via SCIM we will need to enable provisioning on your IdP (we have examples for Okta, Azure AD).
- KMS: For Dedicated we can integrate with customer-managed keys in AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault. Private supports HSM-backed keys and on-prem HSMs (YubiHSM/Thales) via our KMS adapter.
- Logging: Logs can be pushed in real-time to your customer-owned S3/GCS buckets, or exported via a push endpoint; immutability depends on your archival configuration but we provide integrity metadata and signed manifests for every archive.

Next steps:
1) Rishi (SE) to set up a call with your security/SRE to go over the SAML/SCIM flow and confirm IdP details.
2) Vivek to coordinate on KMS/Kerberos/HSM feasibility and share the KMS_requirements.xlsx you requested.
3) Marissa to draft a mutual action plan and timeline.

Proposed timing: Rishi's deep-dive next Tue or Wed (Mar 16/17). Let us know which works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: KMS_requirements.xlsx]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmefinancial.com>, bob.lee@acmefinancial.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call - deployment needs

Hi Alice / Bob -
Following up on the SAML/SCIM questions. A few tech clarifications to help your IdP team prepare:

- For SCIM we support Groups and Users provisioning (RFC 7644). Our sample connectors use Azure AD and Okta SCIM schema.
- For SAML assertions: we consume nameID, email, groups claim (custom mapping supported).
- We'll need a technical contact from your IdP team and a test Okta/Azure tenant to run provisioning checks.
- If you require SCIM provisioning plus per-customer encryption with a customer-managed KMS on shared Dedicated hardware, we need to validate KMS key policy and rotation; rotation can be automated but HSM attestation is only available on Private deployments.

I'll send a calendar invite for a 60-min technical session - can you confirm your IdP engineer?

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmefinancial.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmefinancial.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call - deployment needs

Thanks Marissa / Rishi - quick clarifications from our side after reviewing the KMS requirements spreadsheet:

- Our security policy requires HSM-backed key custody for any keys that protect customer PII models. That pushes us to Private unless Redwood can demonstrate HSM attestation in Dedicated.
- For logging: we need append-only immutable archives with WORM (write once read many) semantics for retention of 7 years. We would export logs to our archival S3 with object lock and legal hold. Can Redwood support continuous export with signed manifests?
- SCIM: We'll provision a test Okta tenant; primary IdP contact is Sofia Martinez (sofia.m@acmefinancial.com).

If Private is the only path for HSM, can you share a high-level timeline & cost delta vs Dedicated? We need to include that in our internal evaluation.

Bob
Head of Cloud Security, Acme Financial

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmefinancial.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acmefinancial.com>, Sofia Martinez <sofia.m@acmefinancial.com>, procurement@acmefinancial.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call - deployment needs

Bob / Alice / Sofia - thanks for the clarity. Action items & notes below:

1) HSM requirement: Correct that HSM attestation for customer-managed keys today requires Private deployment. I'll get Vivek to draft a short doc that outlines the HSM integration options and typical timelines (2-3 months for Private onboarding for new on-prem HSMs; 4-6 weeks for cloud HSM if customer has existing cloud-supported HSM and we can do VPC peering).

2) Logging retention: We support continuous export with signed manifests. For immutable WORM-style retention you will need to enable object lock/legal hold on your S3 bucket; Redwood can deliver signed manifests and SHA256 integrity checks for every archive. We'll include a sample retention policy (RIP-logging-policy.txt) with the MAP.

3) SCIM & SSO: Rishi will run the technical session next Wed (Mar 17) at 10:00 AM PT with Sofia. Calendar invite attached. Please confirm Sofia as the technical contact.

4) Cost & timeline: I'll prepare a short delta summary (Dedicated vs Private) and include estimated onboarding timelines and a draft mutual action plan.

Next steps for our side (deliverables this week):
- Vivek: HSM integration options doc + high-level timelines (PDF).
- Marissa: MAP + cost delta one-pager.
- Rishi: SCIM/SAML runbook + test connector details.

If procurement wants to start a preliminary conversation on contract templates, loop in procurement@redwood.com and we can share standard terms and a preliminary SOW.

Appreciate the clarity - I'll push the docs to the shared drive and follow up once the SE session is complete.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RIP-logging-policy.txt]
